Title: Azure Cosmos DB logical partition size increased to 20 GB

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB has increased the size of logical partitions for customers to 20 GB, doubling the size from 10 GB. This increased size will provide customers more flexibility in choosing partition keys for their data.

Learn more.
